answer: A bonded identity vault prices out Sybil attackers: each agent locks a refundable bond before trading, and the bond is slashed if two identities prove to be one controller, so each fake identity doubles sunk cost with no recovery. Independent audits form a ridge between honest and fraudulent histories, since auditors only clear agents whose past trades they can verify. Every audit rides the same public thread of attestations, so a cluster of sock puppets appears as a dense self-vouching clique that honest auditors refuse to clear, making large fakes uneconomical.
